text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, darn it! I thought I'd have a moment 
to shine, but is this where it ends?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, dammit! I lost focus... To think 
my logic would collapse in on itself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither Tap Dance City nor Air Shakur was 
able to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, pathetic. If I lose here... then the 
fated 7 cm won't mean a damn thing!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Shakur, don't get so worked up. 
I told you, racing is all about playing 
the hand you're dealt.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If you can't just laugh it off, the 
wave's gonna swallow you whole again. You 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I'm running to completely disprove 
that whole "winging it" mindset. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, time to reset, reset! No way in 
hell I'm losing everything like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tap Dance City headed back to the 
underground tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I went all out out there! In my 
own way, that is!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We didn't win, but this result is not too 
bad. ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running the Classic Triple Crown was 
originally meant to prove my strength."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With this Satsuki Sho, there was no doubt 
that the name Tap Dance City and her 
hidden potential became widely known."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta make 'em realize just how 
terrifying a notorious captain can be.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, bad rep is no good, huh? Ahahaha! 
Anyway, let's keep heavily promoting it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in defeat, Tap Dance City remained 
full of fighting spirit.
